subject: Re: Intent recognition kickoff — activity signals API
body: Go/no-go outcome from Thursday: conditional go. The API ships to both partners in Q3, but gated on label quality — we will not train partner-specific models until their data passes a 0.6 kappa bar on re-rated samples. That makes the annotation UI the critical path; Oyin's beta goes to first raters July 13, and Fumiko will run the agreement study over the following two weeks. Scope cut to protect that: the second partner's custom activity taxonomy is deferred to Q4; both partners launch on the shared taxonomy. Also noting for the record: the pipeline itself is in good shape — the ADL numbers plus the validation stage were what convinced the review. OKR language went in before the June 26 lock, so no surprises there. Thanks all. Dmitri
